Saturday hike: Bukhansan or Gwanaksan

Pick Gwanaksan, Seoul National University route. It is the gentler climb, which matters for Dana's knee.

Bukhansan (Bukhansanseong route) Gwanaksan (SNU route)
Distance to the first viewpoint 4.1 km 3.2 km
Climb 520 m 290 m
Rain chance, 8 am to 1 pm 10 to 15% 5 to 15%
Rain chance at 4 pm 55% 45%

Plan

  • Start by 10 am and be down by 2 pm, when the rain chance passes 20%.
  • The chart (chart.png) shows the hourly rain chance at both trailheads.
